decision: Use an execution-derived read-only qrexec policy collector before any state-changing Qubes worker qualification.
winner: injected real-invocation collector with before/after durable-state digests and immediate qualification verification

correctness.reason: The final LAB READY artifact is built from the same invocation observations, attestation check, framing facts, and mutation snapshots produced by the qualification run rather than hand-entered scenario facts.

robustnessSecurity.reason: Wrong service, wrong identity, bad auth, malformed framing, mutation drift, failed attestation, oversized output, or multi-frame output all prevent qualification. The collector does not need request secrets, lease tokens, private keys, raw mission payloads, or stack traces in its report.

latencyResources.reason: It adds no production daemon, database, WAL, MissionQueue mutation, or extra production qrexec round trip; it only sequences the explicit qualification invocations and two state snapshots.

regressionRisk.reason: Readiness semantics remain centralized in qrexec-readonly-policy-qualification.mjs rather than duplicated in the collector.

qa.winner: contract tests plus real-Qubes injected runner
qa.reason: Synthetic tests prove fail-closed orchestration while the same collector can accept the real qrexec invocation and coordinator-side snapshot functions in a Qubes lab.

rejected.reason: Schema-valid evidence is not causal proof that the expected qrexec routes were actually exercised.
It mixes policy/auth/framing failures with MissionQueue semantics and unnecessarily increases blast radius before read-only routing is proven.
Adds lifecycle, RAM, IPC, and attack surface without improving the read-only acceptance proof.

lessons: A policy qualification gate should consume execution observations, not operator assertions.
Read-only routing evidence must prove both intended allow and explicit deny cases.
Zero mutation is strongest when measured independently with before/after durable-state digests.
The collector is not itself proof of Qubes policy; REAL-WORKER readiness still requires observations from actual Qubes VM invocation.
safety: Synthetic and defensive qualification only. No real financial transactions, payment data, fraud workflows, or weakened security controls.
